name: wc-product-sidebar
description: A production-ready WooCommerce WordPress plugin that adds a React-based slide-in product sidebar to any page of your store.

scripts.zip: npm --prefix frontend run build && rm -f wc-product-sidebar.zip && zip -r wc-product-sidebar.zip . -x 'node_modules/*' 'frontend/node_modules/*' 'frontend/src/*' '.git/*' '.commandcode/*' '*.zip' '.DS_Store'
